title: pretty JUNIPER|Plus Size Bodycon Sequin Slit Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
This plus size gown offers shape without the squeeze. The wide-shoulder design supports the upper body, while the softly ruched waist helps smooth the midsection. Full sequin coverage adds polish, and the slit brings ease of movement to a formal look. Whether you're heading to a wedding or dressing up for a special celebration, this piece lets you feel secure, elegant, and part of the moment?awithout overthinking it.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
